title: Department of Transportation: Phase 56K Exact-Record Decision
publisher: Department of Transportation Office of Inspector General
summary: DOT OIG's authoritative page still identifies the FY 2026 information-security review as initiated. The public rail does not yet supply the review result or a dated recommendation-closure decision. Phase 56K decision: Retain Partially Closed. Audit initiation defines the next review identity but cannot be converted into an audit result or remediation outcome.
key_findings: Named record: FY 2026 review result or dated recommendation closure.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when DOT OIG publishes the FY 2026 result or a dated recommendation-status change.
why_it_matters: The decision records an exact acquisition result, including a verified non-closure, without substituting an adjacent record.
ftfn_relevance: Separates current record status from entity performance.
Keeps denominator, attribution, limitation, and reopening rule attached.
evidence_limits: Audit initiation is not an audit result, recommendation closure, control-effectiveness finding, incident measure, or service outcome.
FY 2026 FISMA result, recommendation-level closure, tested-control outcome, incidents, recovery, and transportation-service effects.
No causal effect, entity ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
